Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane on a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle operated by
Driver 2 moved over from the right lane and contacted the left side of Driver 1's vehicle during a lane change. Driver 1
reported pain in the left knee after striking the interior trim during the impact and said a Passenger was also seated in
the veihcle at the time. I arrived on scene and observed that Driver 1 was present and was consistent in describing
the sequence of events. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general location of contact and the damage to
both vehicles. No independent witnesses came forward. The visible damage is largely consistent with the sideswipe
described by both drivers. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known or reported to me. Driver 1 is listed as a
named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. A report of the injury was noted, and the reproted knee complaint is
a plausible result of a collision of this type.
